mapper.sql: select ac.attendance_correction_id, ac.emp_id, ac.work_date, ac.request_check_in_at, ac.request_check_out_at, ac.reason, ac.status, ac.request_date, ac.approver_id, ac.approved_at, ac.reject_reason, e.emp_no, e.ename, d.department_id, d.department_name, j.job_name, ap.ename as approver_name, apj.job_name as approver_job_name, a.check_in_at as current_check_in_at, a.check_out_at as current_check_out_at from attendance_correction ac join emp e on e.emp_id = ac.emp_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id join job j on j.job_id = e.job_id left join emp ap on ap.emp_id = ac.approver_id left join job apj on apj.job_id = ap.job_id left join attendance a on a.emp_id = ac.emp_id and a.work_date = ac.work_date
mapper.insert: insert into attendance_correction(emp_id, work_date, request_check_in_at, request_check_out_at, reason, status, request_date, approver_id) values(#{emp.empId}, #{workDate}, #{requestCheckInAt}, #{requestCheckOutAt}, #{reason}, 'REQUESTED', #{requestDate}, #{approver.empId})

choose.when: order by ac.approved_at desc, ac.attendance_correction_id desc limit 100
